column1: # One glob per line. '*' matches any run of characters within a case id (the whole
# pipe-delimited field, tabs excluded since a case id never contains one). Lines
# starting with # and blank lines are ignored. A waived case is reported separately
# from PASS/FAIL and never fails the run, no matter what it changed to or whether it
# now throws, stopped throwing, or produced different numbers.
# Use this to declare "these rows are expected to change" for a specific PR instead
# of the alternative, which is quietly loosening the comparison for everyone.

column2: swe_house_pos throws IndexOutOfRangeException for hsys 'G' (Gauquelin sectors): its internal cusp array is sized for 12 houses but Gauquelin needs 36. Expected to stop throwing once the 2.10.03 port delta lands; remove this waiver at that point so the fixed values get frozen instead.
